title: Cafda, Retreat (approx.): man, 30, and woman, 46, shot dead at home, 9 Oct
summary: SAPS says a 30-year-old man and a 46-year-old woman were shot dead at their home in Cafda, Retreat, on Friday 9 October at about 09:15, when gunmen chasing a rival gang member who ran onto the property missed him and hit...
story: SAPS says a 30-year-old man and a 46-year-old woman were shot dead at their home in Cafda, Retreat, on Friday 9 October at about 09:15, when gunmen chasing a rival gang member who ran onto the property missed him and hit them. Anti-Gang Unit detectives arrested a 32-year-old man on 14 October; he was due in the Wynberg Magistrates' Court on 16 October on two murder charges. Two men arrested after a chase on 9 October face firearm and stolen-property charges, not murder (Cape Argus). Reports name the street as Ensor or Enzo Street.
location_note: Cafda Village, Retreat. Reports differ on the street (Ensor or Enzo), so the pin is the suburb's map point.

provenance.note: Three outlets, all resting on police. Cape Coast News and People's Post retell the SAPS arrest statement, including the provincial commissioner's praise; Cape Argus quotes police spokesperson F.C. van Wyk. No non-police source.
